sd-civitai-browser-plus.desc: Extension to access CivitAI via WebUI: download, delete, scan for updates, list installed models, assign tags, and boost downloads with multi-threading.

HanahiraVRCTools.desc: One-click Windows repair toolkit for VRChat — fix crashes, EAC, cache, IME, Discord hook, network & audio. Single .bat, no install.

ClaudeHanahiraUI.desc: Interface mod for Claude Code 🌸 Adds a status band above the prompt with ring gauges (context, 5h/7d limits), cost/token/time cards, live agent cards, and styled conversation logs. Bun + TypeScript.

kikitan-translator.desc: Real-time speech translation for VRChat. Transcribes and translates your voice into the chatbox via OSC, with desktop-audio subtitles and a VR overlay. 27 input / 50+ output languages. Fork of YusufOzmen01/kikitan-translator.
